name: Gen2 soft denoise around LanPaint
plain: Wraps the LanPaint sampler so it can use a soft mask, since LanPaint itself binarises the denoise mask at 0.5. The wrapper blends the input toward a noised reference before the call, and blends the output toward a reference after. The reference can be the source, the latest generated output, or an EMA of generated outputs.
math:
s=soft mask·hard envelope (after any denoise_mask_function).
x_w = x·mᵢ + N(ref,σ)·(1−mᵢ), mᵢ=effective_edit_mask(s, strengthᵢ(step)).
raw = LanPaint(x_w,σ,binary mask).
out = raw·mₒ + ref_out·(1−mₒ).
x is overwritten with x_w. ref is original_source, latest_generated or ema_generated (default EMA momentum 0.7); mixed_original_latest picks a per-pixel mix of original and latest through a curve on s, with its own step or sigma schedule.

providers.author: petmycat
providers.note: Requires image latents; helper functions read by signature, the proxy call in full
